reviews.title: Perfect Gift for a Chess Lover
reviews.body: I bought this folding wooden chess board set as a gift for my boyfriend, who is obsessed with chess, and he absolutely loves it. The board looks really nice and classic, and the folding design makes it easy to store the pieces without losing anything.The wood feels solid and well made, and the pieces have a nice weight to them, which makes playing even more enjoyable. He uses it all the time—at home, with friends, and even just to set up positions and practice.Overall, this was a great gift and definitely worth it. If you’re buying for someone who loves chess (or wants to get more into it), this set is a great choice. Also a great value for the price if you dont need something too flashy, plus the fact that it comes with two other games!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 7, 2026

reviews.title: Good Budget-Friendly 3-in-1 Game Set With a Few Fixable Flaws
reviews.body: This is a budget-friendly 3-game set — very functional, and I like it overall. It has a plastic-like chessboard surface and light wood sides that look like pine. The edges are quite sharp, but that can be easily fixed with a piece of sandpaper.The screws used for the hinges are extremely short and seem designed to fail quickly. I sanded the wood, applied stain and a layer of varnish, and replaced the screws, and it turned into a really nice set.As it comes from the factory, though, I’m not sure it will hold together for very long.

reviews.title: Excellent Starter Set
reviews.body: Shipped quickly, arrived safely and in good condition.  Checkers/backgammon pieces are one in same and made of wood.  Chess pieces are of a decent size and made of a hard plastic material.  All pieces come in zip lock baggies.  Wooden case is well made.  One of two drawbacks for me personally is there is no handle for ease of transporting.  The second drawback is the instructions are printed on the box sleeve which A) Is tiny print and B) Not clear or thorough enough for Backgammon and Chess.  Purchased a separate Kindle Book on How To Play Chess and looking for one on Backgammon.  I bring this to work (I'm a Nanny) so a handle on it would be beneficial.  The boys I watch want to learn to play Chess and Backgammon.  To begin with we played Checkers which my 9 year old enjoyed immensely!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 10, 2025
